messages.subject: Re: Could some please build matrixStats_0.1.2.tgz for OSX? (Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error installing aroma.affymetrix on Mac OSX R)
parts:
Hi,

sorry about that. The problem occurs because you setup cannot build
the 'matrixStats' package. Unfortunately, I do not have OSX myself,
so neither instruct you how to do this (you need to set it up so you
can build packages from source) nor forward you a prebuild binary
version of the package.

Is there anyone out there with a "powerpc-apple-darwin8.10.1" that
could forward Lax a binary build of 'matrixStats'
(matrixStats_0.1.2.tgz). If so, please send it to the mailing list.
The 13kb source code can be downloaded (to the current directory) by:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
hbGet("matrixStats", "0.1.2", "tar.gz");

If you build it as a "cross-platform"(?) package so that it works on
all different OSX platforms, that would be even better, because then I
can put it on the online repository and that would solve all problems.

Cheers

Henrik

messages.author: fd467cdb4718031f
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Could some please build matrixStats_0.1.2.tgz for OSX? (Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error installing aroma.affymetrix on Mac OSX R)
parts:
Hi,
I have built a ppc version, and what I think is a universal binary,
although the universal binary gets and i386 in its resulting file
name, so i'm not 100% sure on that.

Using: intel MacPro OSX 10.5.4

How:
$ R

> q("no")
then, first build the universal:
$ tar -xzf matrixStats_0.1.2.tar.gz
$ R CMD build --binary matrixStats
see attached matrixStats_0.1.2_R_i386-apple-darwin8.10.1.tar.gz

# then to build just the ppc:
$ export R_ARCH="/ppc"
$ R CMD build --binary matrixStats
see attached matrixStats_0.1.2_R_powerpc-apple-darwin8.10.1.tar.gz

cheers,
Mark

-----------------------------------------------------
Mark Cowley, BSc (Bioinformatics)(Hons)

Peter Wills Bioinformatics Centre
Garvan Institute of Medical Research, Sydney, Australia
-----------------------------------------------------

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Could some please build matrixStats_0.1.2.tgz for OSX? (Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error installing aroma.affymetrix on Mac OSX R)
parts:
Hi Mark,

thanks for this.

This is what I've done: I've uploaded those two files as is to the
repository. I then also uploaded a matrixStats_0.1.2.tgz which is an
exact copy of matrixStats_0.1.2_R_i386-apple-darwin8.10.1.tar.gz. The
latter might or might not work.

So Lax, and other OSX users having issues installing 'matrixStats',
try the following:

Alt 1. Regular installation. Hopefully this work.

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix");


Alt 2. Installing 'matrixStats' "by hand". Try either:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
installPackages("http://www.braju.com/R/repos/matrixStats_0.1.2_R_i386-apple-darwin8.10.1.tar.gz");

or

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R");
installPackages("http://www.braju.com/R/repos/matrixStats_0.1.2_R_powerpc-apple-darwin8.10.1.tar.gz");

Please let us know which alternative worked, if at all.

FYI, when I get around to finalize 'matrixStats' I will probably
upload it to CRAN and it will automatically provide us with OSX (and
Windows) binaries.

Cheers

Henrik
